query:
UPDATE kanban_tasks SET
                goal_phase = 'blocked',
                goal_blocked_code = COALESCE(NULLIF($1, '')::text, goal_blocked_code, 'unspecified'),
                goal_blocked_message = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, '')::text, goal_blocked_message),
                goal_revision = goal_revision + 1,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $3
